---
title: "Junction Classifier Evaluation"
---

```{r setup}
source(here::here("R", "paths.R"))
library(tidyverse)

FIGURES_DIR <- out_path("figures")
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r load-predictions}
# ── Paths ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BASE <- out_path("sequence-classifier")

ENSEMBLE_DIRS <- list(
  "Junction LM Exclusion" = file.path(BASE, "ensemble-output-junction-exclusion"),
  "Junction LM Baseline"  = file.path(BASE, "ensemble-output-junction-baseline")
)

COMPARATOR_MODELS <- c(
  "junction_kmer_glm",
  "junction_kmer_rf",
  "junction_protein_glm",
  "junction_protein_rf"
)

COMPARATOR_LABELS <- c(
  junction_kmer_glm     = "Junction k-mer GLM",
  junction_kmer_rf      = "Junction k-mer RF",
  junction_protein_glm  = "Junction protein GLM",
  junction_protein_rf   = "Junction protein RF"
)

COMPARATOR_BASE <- file.path(BASE, "comparator-output")

# ── Helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
load_ensemble <- function(dir, model_label) {
  bind_rows(
    read_csv(file.path(dir, "unflipped/predictions/ensemble_predictions.csv"),
             show_col_types = FALSE),
    read_csv(file.path(dir, "flipped/predictions/ensemble_predictions.csv"),
             show_col_types = FALSE)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      `prob_Multiple sclerosis` = ms_score,
      Predicted                 = predicted_class,
      Disease                   = true_label
    ) %>%
    mutate(Disease_orig = Disease, model = model_label)
}

# ── LM models ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lm_preds <- imap(ENSEMBLE_DIRS, load_ensemble)

# ── Comparator models ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
comp_preds <- map(COMPARATOR_MODELS, function(m) {
  load_ensemble(file.path(COMPARATOR_BASE, m), COMPARATOR_LABELS[[m]])
})

# ── Combine and filter ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_preds <-
  c(lm_preds, comp_preds) %>%
  map(select, `prob_Multiple sclerosis`, Disease, Disease_orig, Predicted, Author, Subject, model) %>%
  reduce(bind_rows) %>%
  mutate(
    Predicted = if_else(Predicted == "Multiple sclerosis", "Multiple sclerosis", "Other"),
    Disease   = if_else(Disease   == "Multiple sclerosis", "Multiple sclerosis", "Other")
  ) %>%
  # Remove known duplicate / confounded BioProjects
  filter(Author != "PRJNA248475", Author != "PRJNA248411",
         Author != "PRJNA866296") %>%
  # Remove MS twins
  mutate(Disease = if_else(str_detect(Subject, "Twin(?:1|2|3|4)\\.2"), "MS Twin", Disease)) %>%
  mutate(Disease = if_else(str_detect(Subject, "SCNI"),                "MS Twin", Disease)) %>%
  filter(Disease != "MS Twin") %>%
  mutate(
    Disease   = factor(Disease),
    Predicted = factor(Predicted, levels = levels(Disease))
  )
```

```{r model-order}
LM_ORDER <- c(
  "Junction LM Exclusion",
  "Junction LM Baseline"
)

COMP_ORDER <- c(
  "Junction k-mer GLM",
  "Junction k-mer RF",
  "Junction protein GLM",
  "Junction protein RF"
)

MODEL_ORDER <- c(LM_ORDER, COMP_ORDER, "Random (permuted)")

MODEL_COLOURS <- c(
  setNames(
    viridis::viridis(length(MODEL_ORDER) - 1L, option = "D", begin = 0.05, end = 0.9),
    MODEL_ORDER[MODEL_ORDER != "Random (permuted)"]
  ),
  "Random (permuted)" = "grey70"
)
```

```{r prior}
# Prior = MS prevalence in the evaluation set (random baseline achieves this)
prior_main <- all_preds %>%
  filter(model == "Junction LM Exclusion") %>%
  summarize(p = mean(Disease == "Multiple sclerosis")) %>%
  pull(p)
```

```{r topk-fold-curves}
# Continuous precision & recall fold-enrichment curves across top-k thresholds.
CURVE_MODELS  <- MODEL_ORDER[MODEL_ORDER != "Random (permuted)"]
CURVE_X_START <- 0.5   # rightmost top-k fraction (top 50%)

curve_fracs <- seq(CURVE_X_START, 0.00001, length.out = 200)

curve_data <- map_dfr(CURVE_MODELS, function(mod) {
  dat   <- all_preds %>% filter(model == mod)
  n     <- nrow(dat)
  n_pos <- sum(dat$Disease == "Multiple sclerosis")
  map_dfr(curve_fracs, function(f) {
    k    <- max(1L, round(n * f))
    top  <- slice_max(dat, `prob_Multiple sclerosis`, n = k, with_ties = FALSE)
    prec <- mean(top$Disease == "Multiple sclerosis")
    rec  <- if (n_pos > 0) sum(top$Disease == "Multiple sclerosis") / n_pos else NA_real_
    tibble(model = mod, frac = f,
           precision = prec, recall = rec,
           prec_fold = prec / prior_main,
           rec_fold  = rec / frac)
  })
})

CURVE_COLOURS <- MODEL_COLOURS[CURVE_MODELS]

p_prec_curve <- ggplot(curve_data, aes(x = frac, y = prec_fold, colour = model)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  scale_x_reverse(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = CURVE_COLOURS) +
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "none", aspect.ratio = 2) +
  labs(x = "Top-k threshold", y = "Fold enrichment (precision / prior)",
       title = "Precision fold enrichment across top-k", colour = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(transform = 'log2', limits = c(0.5,2))
p_prec_curve
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig2F_precision_fold_curve_junction.svg"),
       p_prec_curve, width = 1.5, height = 3)


```
